text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government says over 1,000 government houses, occupied by civil servants, can be bought by them.
- Three Zambians are killed on Zaire's Pedicle road, bringing to five the number of Zambians killed there over the past two weeks.
- Zambia Detonators Company earns over $500,000 through exports to Zimbabwe, Zaire and Tanzania since the beginning of the year.
- Five notorious bandits are shot dead in a Lusaka township during an exchange of gunfire with police in which one officer is killed.
- Vice president Godfrey Miyanda says over 1,000 jobs will be saved at the Zambia-China Mulungushi Textiles joint venture following a recapitalisation of $9.05 million by the two companies.
- Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines ZCCM.PA (ZCCM) copper exports dropped by 6,346 tonnes in March.
- A Lusaka man sues the University Teaching Hospital for negligence leading to permanent damage of his testicles.
